Question 24(b) [3 marks]: How will the business know that their marketing plan has been successful for a new product range?
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
A business wishes to introduce new products into the market.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 3):
3 marks: Demonstrates a clear understanding of the way the business will know the marketing plan has been successful
2 marks: Demonstrates an understanding of the way the business will know the marketing plan has been successful
1 marks: Makes a relevant statement about the marketing plan

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
In the marketing plan, the business would have developed a financial forecast that included the cost and potential sales of the new product range. The business could monitor and control the marketing plan, comparing actual with planned results in terms of sales and market share to determine the success of their new product range.



WHAT THE REAL MARKERS SAID ABOUT THIS QUESTION:
Better responses: apply correct marketing theory relevant to the introduction of new products
Better responses: demonstrate an understanding of the marketing process and ways to measure the success of a marketing plan related to a new product range (b)
Better responses: clearly show an understanding of the characteristics of each approach to marketing, and provide reasons why the marketing approach was appropriate for the business (c).
To improve: supporting answers with syllabus theory and relevant terminology instead of making general statements
To improve: demonstrating an understanding of the implementation, monitoring and controlling stage of the marketing plan (b)
To improve: understanding there are different approaches to marketing and why the marketing approach is appropriate for a business to use when introducing a new product to the market (c).

STUDENT RESPONSE:
